name: College of Glamour

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A bard touched by the Feywild who charms, beguiles and inspires with otherworldly majesty.

feature.name: Beguiling Magic
feature.summary: Charm Person and Mirror Image always prepared; after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, Charm or Frighten a creature within 60 feet.
feature.text: You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. Immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can have one creature you can see within 60 feet make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC; on a failure it is Charmed or Frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Once used, you need a Long Rest or a use of Bardic Inspiration to do it again.

feature.name: Mantle of Inspiration
feature.summary: Bonus Action: spend Bardic Inspiration to give up to Cha-modifier creatures Temporary Hit Points (twice the die) and a free move.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you expend a use of Bardic Inspiration and roll the die. Choose other creatures within 60 feet of you, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one); each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the roll and can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature.name: Mantle of Majesty
feature.summary: Command is always prepared; Bonus Action: cast it without a slot and keep casting it each turn for 1 minute.
feature.text: You always have Command prepared. As a Bonus Action you can cast Command without a spell slot and take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute (Concentration). While it lasts you can cast Command as a Bonus Action on each of your turns without a slot, and creatures Charmed by you automatically fail their saves against it. Once used, you need a Long Rest or a level 3+ spell slot to use it again.

feature.name: Unbreakable Majesty
feature.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute, a creature that attacks you must make a Charisma save or choose another target.
